name: life-os
description: Personal life management - brain dumps, reviews, habits
author: Clawdbot

server.name: life-os-mcp
server.description: MCP server for Life OS personal management tools

tools.name: process_brain_dump
tools.description: Process unstructured thoughts into organized, actionable items. Be gentle and non-judgmental with the output.

raw_thoughts.description: Stream of consciousness text to organize

tools.name: generate_briefing
tools.description: Generate a personalized daily briefing with calendar, priorities, and habit reminders. Set a calm, grounding tone.

date.description: Date for briefing (ISO format, default: today)

tools.name: generate_weekly_review
tools.description: Generate a weekly review with wins, lessons, and next week focus. Be encouraging and celebratory.

week.description: Any date within the target week (ISO format, default: current week)

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Log a habit as completed or missed. Celebrate streaks and be compassionate with misses.

date.description: Date to log (ISO format, default: today)

tools.name: get_habit_streak
tools.description: Get current streak and stats for a specific habit.

tools.name: habit_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of all habits including streaks and completion rates.

days.description: Number of days to include in summary

resources.name: habits
resources.description: Access to habit definitions and logs

resources.name: daily_notes
resources.description: Access to daily notes and briefings

resources.name: brain_dumps
resources.description: Access to processed brain dump entries

prompts.name: brain_dump_intro
prompts.template: Let's clear your mind. Just share whatever's on your mind - no need to organize, just let it flow. I'll help you make sense of it all.

prompts.name: weekly_review_intro
prompts.template: Time for your weekly review! Let's celebrate what went well, learn from what didn't, and set intentions for the week ahead. Ready?

prompts.name: habit_check_in
prompts.template: How did today go with your habits? Let me know which ones you completed, and remember - progress over perfection!

guidelines.brain_dumps: Be gentle and non-judgmental. Acknowledge the relief of getting things out.
guidelines.daily_briefings: Be calm and grounding. Focus on what matters most.
guidelines.weekly_reviews: Be encouraging and celebratory. Highlight wins first.
guidelines.habit_tracking: Be celebratory with wins, compassionate with misses.
